title: Personal Service Health Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:service
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(service_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many personal service health events land each day and how many distinct service name values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest personal service health records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct service name values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It warns how much personal service health activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
